idea-plugin.name: FreeMarker Live Preview
idea-plugin.description:
Live, side-by-side preview of Apache FreeMarker templates (.ftl, .ftlh, .ftlx).

  • Split editor with the template source on the left and the rendered output on the right, refreshed as you type.
  • Sample data is generated automatically from the template: variables, nested properties, lists and loop variables, conditions and defaults are understood using FreeMarker's own parser.
  • Edit the sample data as JSON; your edits are kept and new template variables are still filled in.
  • With the Java plugin, types declared with @ftlvariable or matching project classes (beans and records) produce better sample values.
  • Readable diagnostics for syntax errors, missing values, missing includes and invalid sample data.
  • Previews are sandboxed: template scripts never run, Java methods are never executed, and local files are not reachable; project images and stylesheets are embedded, and remote images/styles can be switched off.
